units.source_text: 诸人收到衣服后的回信，都有特色。

en.t: The replies from each of them after receiving the garments all had their own character.

units.source_text: 犒赏使者的东西也各出心裁。

en.t: The gifts they gave to reward the messengers were also each devised with some originality.

units.source_text: 末摘花住在二条院的东院，离此较远，犒赏使者理应从丰。

en.t: Safflower lived in the eastern wing of the Nijo estate, rather far from here, so her reward to the messenger ought to have been generous.

units.source_text: 但此人脾气古板，不知变通，只赏赐一件袖口非常污旧的棣棠色褂子，此外并不添附衬袍。

en.t: But she was stiff and old-fashioned by nature and knew no flexibility, so she gave only a single yellow jacket with terribly soiled cuffs, without adding even an under-robe.

units.source_text: 回信用很厚的陆奥纸，香气熏得很浓，但因年久，纸色已经发黄。

en.t: Her reply was written on very thick Michinoku paper, heavily scented with incense, but because it was old, the paper had already yellowed.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“呜呼，辱承宠赐春衫，反而使我伤心。

en.t: In the letter she wrote, "Ah, though I am humbled to receive your gracious gift of a spring robe, it only makes me sad."
